description: Autopilot hooks for autonomous operation and context management

hooks.command: if [ -f .autopilot/mission.json ] && grep -q '"active"' .autopilot/mission.json 2>/dev/null; then echo '## Autopilot Session Active'; echo ''; cat .autopilot/handoff.md 2>/dev/null || echo 'No handoff notes.'; echo ''; echo '---'; echo 'Progress:'; grep -o '"status"[[:space:]]*:[[:space:]]*"[^"]*"' .autopilot/progress.json 2>/dev/null | sort | uniq -c || echo 'No progress data.'; fi
